corrections.correction: Brook et al. give 12,799–12,049 cal BP, not 12,799–12,653 cal BP; mylodontid bones discussed separately are from La Gruta 3.
The dated individual is historic, with multimodal calibrated ranges in 1698–1905 cal AD, rather than an early or middle Holocene pioneer.
Martin reinterprets the rockfall as incomplete and does not accept it as a simple seal dividing all Pleistocene and Holocene activity.
The abstract proposes at least two millennia, not one millennium; it is an older regional colonization model, not a verified mapped route.
Prates 2013 and Civalero/Franco 2003 radiocarbon-year statements are not arithmetically converted to calendar years.
Published online in December 2025, journal issue 2026; preserve both rather than treating these as two studies.
Abrigo 1 is a Tandilia/Pampas comparison, not a Patagonian settlement.
Sampled-site gaps and changes in projectile-point deposition do not directly establish an empty landscape or a resident-population decline.

corrections.target: Baño Nuevo natural versus cultural antiquity
corrections.correction: A 16,000-year cave history includes prehuman animal deposits; early human component and burials are much younger.
